## What's Changed
* Remove native code left unused by the connectcore cutover by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/151
* Remove unused broker bridge operations by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/152
* Remove unused Android strings and native config constants by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/153
* Bump @maplibre/maplibre-react-native to 11.5.1 to fix an iOS map crash by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/155
* Promote 1.0.0: iOS 1.0.0 and release notice by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/149
* Remove unread broker URL constants and correct the telemetry runbook by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/154
* Warn when the device's date and time look wrong by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/156
* Lay out wide windows with a navigation rail and a docked home panel by @plastic-chinchilla in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/158
* Release 1.0.1: point iOS at the App Store by @openrung-admin in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/160

## New Contributors
* @plastic-chinchilla made their first contribution in https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/pull/158

detail.readme:
# OpenRung Mobile **Reach the open internet, from your phone.** OpenRung helps people living behind internet censorship reach blocked websites and apps. It connects your phone to a nonprofit relay network operated by the OpenRung Foundation and community volunteers. [Android](https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/releases/latest) · [iOS beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/RMTt4UfQ) · [Website](https://openrung.org) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/issues)


OpenRung on iOS

## Get started 1. **Install the app.** On Android, download the APK from the [latest release](https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/releases/latest). On iPhone, join the [TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/RMTt4UfQ). 2. **Tap Connect** and allow the VPN connection when your phone asks. 3. **Browse as usual.** OpenRung chooses a relay automatically. To choose one yourself, tap a location on the map or switch to the relay list. Tap **Disconnect** whenever you want to stop. ## What you can do - **Choose where you connect.** Explore relay locations on the map or in a list, and reconnect to recent relays. - **Choose what uses the VPN.** Split tunneling lets local-network devices and selected Iranian or Chinese services connect directly. Android also lets you exclude individual apps. - **Share OpenRung.** Send the installed Android APK to someone nearby without internet access, or share the iOS TestFlight invitation from Settings. - **Use your language.** Choose English, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, Persian, Russian, Arabic, Turkish, Vietnamese, or Burmese. ## How it works OpenRung routes your internet traffic through an encrypted connection to a relay. The app handles relay selection and connection recovery, while you use your browser and other apps normally. OpenRung prioritizes access to the internet. **It has no built-in kill switch:** if the VPN connection fails, your phone may use its normal internet connection. Traffic you exclude through split tunneling also uses that direct connection. Split tunneling is on by default for local-network access. Country presets are selected using your device's time zone and can be changed in Settings. Routing choices reset when the app restarts; excluded Android apps are remembered. Read the [privacy policy](https://www.openrung.org/privacy) for information about data handling. ## Help and feedback [Report a bug or suggest an improvement](https://github.com/openrung/openrung-mobile-app/issues). Include your app version, phone model, and a description of what happened. Switching to Persian or Arabic may require an app restart for the layout to change. Android offline sharing requires a complete APK installation; split APK installations cannot be shared this way. ## For developers The app uses React Native with a shared Go VPN engine on Android and iOS. - [Build and test from source](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) - [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [native contract](docs/CONTRACT.md) - [Release process](RELEASE.md) and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) ## License OpenRung Mobile is open source under [GPL-3.0-or-later](LICENSE). Built with [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box), [MapLibre](https://maplibre.org/), and [React Native](https://reactnative.dev/). OpenRung is not affiliated with or endorsed by sing-box or MapLibre.
